items.title: 4.1.7.1 Operations on Tree (Insertion, Deletion, Traversal: In-order, Pre-order, Post-order; Searching) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of tree operations (PDF 109-111).

items: Insertion: durust jagah dhoond kar naya node us ke walid se jorna, jaise khandan mein naya fard.
Deletion: node ehtiyat se hatana ta ke baqi tree jura rahe.
Traversal: har node muqarrar tarteeb mein dekhna: in-order, pre-order ya post-order.
Searching: matlooba node milne tak tree ke nodes jaanchna.

blocks.alt: Teeron wala binary tree: oopar 1; us ka baen bachcha 2 aur daen bachcha 3; 2 ke neeche 4 aur 5; 3 ke neeche 6 aur 7.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.8: Adadi data wala tree (kitab ki Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; traversals ke mutabiq 2 baen taraf).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.8 ulti (mirror) chhapi hai: us mein 3 baen taraf (neeche 7, 6) aur 2 daen taraf (neeche 5, 4) hai. Magar kitab ke apne jawab, maslan in-order 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7, tabhi sahi hain jab 2 baen aur 3 daen ho. Is liye yahan durust tree banaya gaya hai. In-order: pehle baen shaakh (4, 2, 5), phir jarr 1, phir daen shaakh (6, 3, 7).

blocks.caption: Jarr 1, bachche 2 aur 3, aur patte 4, 5, 6, 7 wale tree ke traversals

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa traversal bachchon se pehle jarr dekhta hai (MCQ 7)?
In-order, pre-order aur post-order traversal misal ke saath samjhaiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Har ek har shaakh ke liye recursive taur par tay hai. In-order pehle baen shaakh, phir node, phir daen shaakh: oopar wale tree par 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7. Pre-order node ko shaakhon se pehle: 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7, oopar se neeche copy ya backup ke liye mufeed. Post-order node ko shaakhon ke baad: 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1, folder se pehle us ka mawad mitane ke liye mufeed.

items: Tree ke amal: insert, delete, traverse, search; in-order 4,2,5,1,6,3,7; pre-order 1,2,4,5,3,6,7; post-order 4,5,2,6,7,3,1.
